qualifiers.reporting_period: calendar year ended December 31, 2025 unless a target year or base year is explicitly named
qualifiers.page_coordinates: one-based PDF page indexes, not printed footer pages inferred from section numbering
qualifiers.ghg_calculation: sum 2025 Scope 1, market-based Scope 2 and reported Scope 3; compare with market-based total; do not substitute location-based Scope 2
qualifiers.target_subject: Schneider Electric Group targets only; do not substitute the separately disclosed AVEVA targets
qualifiers.water_boundary: total withdrawal excludes cooling water returned without impact; cooling water is separately measured
qualifiers.safety_boundary: reported groups are Schneider Electric employees and temporary workers; LTIR uses lost-time accidents times one million divided by hours worked
qualifiers.women_boundary: new hires, frontline management and leadership are distinct populations; leadership means VPs and above excluding direct reports to the CEO
qualifiers.assurance_boundary: statutory limited-assurance certification of CSRD/Article 8 information is distinct from voluntary reasonable assurance over five selected indicators
qualifiers.reference_type: simulated expert reference; not independent human gold
qualifiers.cloud_transmission: prohibited until user authorizes the named report, exact pages, model and Stage A/Stage B scope
